# india-festival-dates (vendored)

This directory contains the compiled `dist/` output of
[paperdropio/india-festival-dates](https://github.com/paperdropio/india-festival-dates),
vendored so MySkylight can calculate Hindu festival and Panchang dates without
depending on an unpublished npm package.

- Upstream commit: `d997624aaf63840bf30fb58f50a04cad8d82f47b` (2026-11-02)
- License: MIT — see `LICENSE`
- Runtime dependency: [`astronomy-engine`](https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy) (MIT)

Do not edit these files directly. To update, rebuild the upstream project and
copy its `dist/*.js` and `dist/festivals/*.js` files here.
